# DB Feature

Pick exactly one case. Both cases generate `shared/types/database.types.ts` with the Supabase CLI through the same cross-platform script.

## Shared (both cases)

### Path: shared/types/database.types.ts
Placeholder so type imports resolve before the first generation. Overwritten by `npm run db:types`.
```ts
// Generated by `npm run db:types`. Do not edit by hand.
export type Json = string | number | boolean | null | { [key: string]: Json | undefined } | Json[]

export interface Database {
  public: {
    Tables: Record<string, never>
    Views: Record<string, never>
    Functions: Record<string, never>
    Enums: Record<string, never>
    CompositeTypes: Record<string, never>
  }
}
```

### Path: scripts/db-types.mjs
```js
// Generates shared/types/database.types.ts with the Supabase CLI.
// Reads env from .env.local via `node --env-file` (Node >= 20.6).
//   DATABASE_URL            -> `supabase gen types --db-url` (any Postgres/PostgREST setup)
//   SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID +
//   SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN   -> `supabase gen types --project-id` (hosted Supabase)
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'

const out = 'shared/types/database.types.ts'
const args = ['supabase', 'gen', 'types', 'typescript', '--schema', 'public']

if (process.env.DATABASE_URL) {
  args.push('--db-url', process.env.DATABASE_URL)
}
else if (process.env.SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID) {
  args.push('--project-id', process.env.SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID)
}
else {
  console.error('Set DATABASE_URL or SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID (+ SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN) in .env.local')
  process.exit(1)
}

const result = spawnSync('npx', args, {
  encoding: 'utf8',
  env: process.env,
  shell: process.platform === 'win32',
  maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
})

if (result.status !== 0) {
  process.stderr.write(result.stderr || '')
  process.exit(result.status ?? 1)
}

mkdirSync('shared/types', { recursive: true })
writeFileSync(out, `// Generated by \`npm run db:types\`. Do not edit by hand.\n${result.stdout}`, 'utf8')
console.log(`wrote ${out}`)
```

### Path: package.json
Add script:
```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "db:types": "node --env-file=.env.local scripts/db-types.mjs"
  }
}
```

### Path: terminal command
```bash
npm install -D supabase
```

---

## Case 1: `@nuxtjs/supabase`

### Path: nuxt.config.ts
Add to `modules`:
```ts
'@nuxtjs/supabase',
```

Add top-level. `redirect: false` is required when Supabase is used for data only; the auth feature turns it on with its own options.
```ts
supabase: {
  redirect: false,
  types: '~~/shared/types/database.types.ts',
},
```

### Path: .env.local
```dotenv
# Supabase
NUXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="https://<project>.supabase.co"
NUXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_KEY="your_publishable_or_anon_key"
NUXT_SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY="your_secret_or_service_role_key"

# Type generation (npm run db:types)
SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID="your_project_ref"
SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN="your_personal_access_token"
```

### Path: .env.production
```dotenv
# Supabase
NUXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="https://<project>.supabase.co"
NUXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_KEY="your_publishable_or_anon_key"
NUXT_SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY="your_secret_or_service_role_key"
```

If the installed `@nuxtjs/supabase` is older than 2.0, use the legacy names `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_KEY` and `SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY` instead.

### Path: terminal command
```bash
npm install @nuxtjs/supabase
```

Usage: `useSupabaseClient<Database>()` in the app, `serverSupabaseClient(event)` / `serverSupabaseServiceRole(event)` on the server.

## Case 2: `nuxt-postgrest` (local module)

A thin wrapper around `@supabase/postgrest-js` for any PostgREST endpoint (self-hosted Supabase, Neon Data API, plain PostgREST). Local modules under `modules/` are auto-registered; do not add it to `modules`.

Three clients:
- `usePostgrest(token?)` — app side, runs as the signed-in user when a `postgrestToken` is in the session (RLS applies).
- `usePostgrestUser(event, token?)` — same thing in server routes.
- `usePostgrestAdmin()` — server only, service key, bypasses RLS.

`mintPostgrestToken()` signs a user JWT with the PostgREST secret so RLS policies can read `request.jwt.claims ->> 'sub'`.

### Path: modules/nuxt-postgrest/index.ts
```ts
import { addImports, addServerImports, createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from '@nuxt/kit'
import { defu } from 'defu'

export interface ModuleOptions {
  /** PostgREST base URL. Env: NUXT_PUBLIC_PGRST_URL */
  url?: string
  /** Anonymous JWT for unauthenticated queries. Env: NUXT_PUBLIC_PGRST_KEY */
  key?: string
}

export default defineNuxtModule<ModuleOptions>({
  meta: {
    name: 'nuxt-postgrest',
    configKey: 'postgrest',
    compatibility: { nuxt: '>=4.0.0' },
  },
  defaults: {},
  setup(options, nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)

    // Keys must exist in runtimeConfig so NUXT_PUBLIC_PGRST_* / NUXT_PGRST_* env vars can fill them.
    nuxt.options.runtimeConfig.public = defu(nuxt.options.runtimeConfig.public, {
      pgrstUrl: options.url ?? '',
      pgrstKey: options.key ?? '',
    })
    nuxt.options.runtimeConfig = defu(nuxt.options.runtimeConfig, {
      pgrstSecretKey: '', // NUXT_PGRST_SECRET_KEY: service-role JWT
      pgrstJwtSecret: '', // NUXT_PGRST_JWT_SECRET: PostgREST `jwt-secret`, used to mint user tokens
    })

    // Pre-bundle for the dev server so the first request does not stall on optimisation.
    nuxt.options.vite.optimizeDeps ||= {}
    nuxt.options.vite.optimizeDeps.include ||= []
    nuxt.options.vite.optimizeDeps.include.push('@supabase/postgrest-js')

    addImports([
      { name: 'usePostgrest', from: resolver.resolve('./runtime/app/composables/usePostgrest') },
      { name: 'createPostgrestClient', from: resolver.resolve('./runtime/shared/createPostgrestClient') },
    ])

    addServerImports([
      { name: 'usePostgrestAdmin', from: resolver.resolve('./runtime/server/utils/usePostgrestAdmin') },
      { name: 'usePostgrestUser', from: resolver.resolve('./runtime/server/utils/usePostgrestUser') },
      { name: 'mintPostgrestToken', from: resolver.resolve('./runtime/server/utils/mintPostgrestToken') },
      { name: 'createPostgrestClient', from: resolver.resolve('./runtime/shared/createPostgrestClient') },
    ])
  },
})
```

### Path: modules/nuxt-postgrest/runtime/shared/createPostgrestClient.ts
```ts
import { PostgrestClient } from '@supabase/postgrest-js'
import type { Database } from '#shared/types/database.types'

type SchemaName = string & keyof Database

export interface CreatePostgrestClientOptions<S extends SchemaName = 'public'> {
  url: string
  /** JWT sent as `Authorization: Bearer` */
  token: string
  /** Postgres schema exposed by PostgREST (`db-schemas`). Defaults to `public`. */
  schema?: S
  headers?: Record<string, string>
}

export function createPostgrestClient<S extends SchemaName = 'public'>(options: CreatePostgrestClientOptions<S>) {
  const { url, token, schema, headers = {} } = options

  if (!url) throw new Error('[nuxt-postgrest] url is required')
  if (!token) throw new Error('[nuxt-postgrest] token is required')

  return new PostgrestClient<Database, S>(url, {
    schema,
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      apikey: token,
      ...headers,
    },
  })
}
```

### Path: modules/nuxt-postgrest/runtime/app/composables/usePostgrest.ts
Pick the variant for the selected Auth.

**Auth is `nuxt-auth-utils`:**
```ts
import { useRuntimeConfig, useUserSession } from '#imports'
import { createPostgrestClient } from '../../shared/createPostgrestClient'

/**
 * PostgREST client for app code. Uses the signed-in user's token from the session when present,
 * otherwise the anonymous key.
 */
export function usePostgrest(token?: string) {
  const { pgrstUrl, pgrstKey } = useRuntimeConfig().public
  if (!pgrstUrl) throw new Error('[nuxt-postgrest] Missing NUXT_PUBLIC_PGRST_URL')

  const { session } = useUserSession()
  return createPostgrestClient({ url: pgrstUrl, token: token || session.value?.postgrestToken || pgrstKey })
}
```

**Any other Auth (or none):**
```ts
import { useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'
import { createPostgrestClient } from '../../shared/createPostgrestClient'

/** PostgREST client for app code. Pass a user JWT for RLS-scoped queries; defaults to the anonymous key. */
export function usePostgrest(token?: string) {
  const { pgrstUrl, pgrstKey } = useRuntimeConfig().public
  if (!pgrstUrl) throw new Error('[nuxt-postgrest] Missing NUXT_PUBLIC_PGRST_URL')

  return createPostgrestClient({ url: pgrstUrl, token: token || pgrstKey })
}
```

### Path: modules/nuxt-postgrest/runtime/server/utils/usePostgrestUser.ts
Pick the variant for the selected Auth.

**Auth is `nuxt-auth-utils`:**
```ts
import type { H3Event } from 'h3'
import { getUserSession, useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'
import { createPostgrestClient } from '../../shared/createPostgrestClient'

/** Server-side PostgREST client running as the request's signed-in user (RLS applies). */
export async function usePostgrestUser(event: H3Event, token?: string) {
  const { pgrstUrl, pgrstKey } = useRuntimeConfig().public
  if (!pgrstUrl) throw new Error('[nuxt-postgrest] Missing NUXT_PUBLIC_PGRST_URL')

  const session = await getUserSession(event)
  return createPostgrestClient({ url: pgrstUrl, token: token || session.postgrestToken || pgrstKey })
}
```

**Any other Auth (or none):**
```ts
import type { H3Event } from 'h3'
import { useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'
import { createPostgrestClient } from '../../shared/createPostgrestClient'

/** Server-side PostgREST client. Pass a user JWT for RLS-scoped queries; defaults to the anonymous key. */
export async function usePostgrestUser(_event: H3Event, token?: string) {
  const { pgrstUrl, pgrstKey } = useRuntimeConfig().public
  if (!pgrstUrl) throw new Error('[nuxt-postgrest] Missing NUXT_PUBLIC_PGRST_URL')

  return createPostgrestClient({ url: pgrstUrl, token: token || pgrstKey })
}
```

### Path: modules/nuxt-postgrest/runtime/server/utils/usePostgrestAdmin.ts
```ts
import { useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'
import { createPostgrestClient } from '../../shared/createPostgrestClient'

let adminClient: ReturnType<typeof createPostgrestClient> | null = null

/** Server-only client using the secret key (bypasses RLS). Never import into app code. */
export function usePostgrestAdmin() {
  if (import.meta.client) throw new Error('[nuxt-postgrest] usePostgrestAdmin() is server-only')
  if (adminClient) return adminClient

  const config = useRuntimeConfig()
  const url = config.public.pgrstUrl
  const secretKey = config.pgrstSecretKey

  if (!url) throw new Error('[nuxt-postgrest] Missing NUXT_PUBLIC_PGRST_URL')
  if (!secretKey) throw new Error('[nuxt-postgrest] Missing NUXT_PGRST_SECRET_KEY')

  adminClient = createPostgrestClient({ url, token: secretKey })
  return adminClient
}
```

### Path: modules/nuxt-postgrest/runtime/server/utils/mintPostgrestToken.ts
```ts
import { SignJWT } from 'jose'
import { useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'

export interface PostgrestClaims {
  /** user id; read in RLS as `current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::json ->> 'sub'` */
  sub: string
  /** Postgres role PostgREST switches to. Must exist and be granted to the authenticator role. */
  role?: string
  [claim: string]: unknown
}

/** Signs a PostgREST JWT (HS256) for a user. `expiresIn` is in seconds. */
export async function mintPostgrestToken(claims: PostgrestClaims, expiresIn = 24 * 60 * 60) {
  const { pgrstJwtSecret } = useRuntimeConfig()
  if (!pgrstJwtSecret) throw new Error('[nuxt-postgrest] Missing NUXT_PGRST_JWT_SECRET')

  return new SignJWT({ role: 'authenticated', ...claims })
    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: 'HS256' })
    .setIssuedAt()
    .setExpirationTime(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + expiresIn)
    .sign(new TextEncoder().encode(pgrstJwtSecret))
}
```

### Path: server/utils/db.ts
Module-level admin handle for server code that is not request-scoped (tasks, cron).
```ts
export const db = usePostgrestAdmin()
```

### Path: .env.local
```dotenv
# nuxt-postgrest
NUXT_PUBLIC_PGRST_URL="https://<host>/rest/v1"
NUXT_PUBLIC_PGRST_KEY="your_anon_jwt"
NUXT_PGRST_SECRET_KEY="your_service_role_jwt"
NUXT_PGRST_JWT_SECRET="the_jwt_secret_postgrest_was_started_with"

# Type generation (npm run db:types)
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db"
```

### Path: .env.production
Same keys as `.env.local` without `DATABASE_URL`.

### Path: terminal command
```bash
npm install @supabase/postgrest-js defu jose
npm install -D @nuxt/kit
```

## Tell the user (postgrest)
- RLS policies see the minted token's claims: `(select current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::json ->> 'sub') = user_id::text`.
- After changing tables, run `NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';` and `npm run db:types`.
